summary: safeGit now returns a GitResult object with code, stdout and stderr instead of a stdout string. It also returns failures as a nonzero code instead of throwing. The GitResult type is now exported from @acme/core.

findings.title: safeGit return type changed while callers still expect a string
findings.problem: safeGit now resolves to a GitResult object instead of a string. The callers currentBranch in packages/cli/src/branch.ts:7 and changedFiles in packages/cli/src/status.ts:6 still call trim and split on that value.
findings.consequence: The CLI fails to compile against the rebuilt core package. Without a type check, changedFiles throws a TypeError and currentBranch returns null for every repository.
findings.fix: Update currentBranch and changedFiles to read the stdout field of the result. Make that update in the same change as the new return type.

findings.title: Failed git commands no longer throw, so callers lose error detection
findings.problem: The new catch block turns every git failure into a returned result. currentBranch in packages/cli/src/branch.ts relies on a thrown error to return null outside a repository.
findings.consequence: Even after the callers read stdout, main.ts never prints the not-a-git-repository error. It reports an empty branch name instead, and changedFiles treats a failed git status as zero changed files.
findings.fix: Make currentBranch return null when the result code is nonzero. Make changedFiles throw or report an error when the result code is nonzero.

findings.title: Changed safeGit behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: This change gives safeGit a new return shape and a new failure path. The repository has no test files that exercise safeGit.
findings.consequence: Nothing catches regressions in the code mapping or in callers that rely on the old shape.
findings.fix: Add tests for safeGit covering a successful command and a failing command. Add tests for the CLI callers that read the result.
